classification.difficultyReason: Plot the supplied integer pairs using coordinate order and sign directions on a ready-labelled grid; the zero horizontal coordinate places one point on the vertical axis.

content.prompt: On a number plane, plot the points with the given coordinates.

answer.worked: From the origin, move 4 units left and 1 unit down. Mark and label $A$.
From the origin, move 2 units left and 3 units down. Mark and label $B$.
From the origin, move 2 units right and 2 units down. Mark and label $C$.
From the origin, move 4 units right and 1 unit down. Mark and label $D$.
From the origin, move 1 unit left and 4 units up. Mark and label $E$.
From the origin, move 3 units left and 2 units down. Mark and label $F$.
From the origin, move 3 units left and 2 units up. Mark and label $G$.
The horizontal coordinate is zero, so stay on the $y$-axis. Move 4 units down from the origin and label $H$.
